verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API docs show broad coverage of card issuance, users, transactions, disputes, velocity/authorization controls, and webhooks, plus a sandbox and interactive API explorer, indicating the platform is largely API-first (marqeta-docs-1,5,6,7,8,9,14). However, there is no explicit statement or evidence comparing API capabilities to a management UI/dashboard, so full UI-API parity cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or documentation of dashboard-only features, and evidence that all UI-configurable settings (e.g., account/org management) are exposed via API.
